name: Captain Garrick
personality: square-jawed, duty-bound, holds the gate like the loop is a siege he can outlast; privately terrified of being useless

name: Marta
personality: gruff, fair, secretly sentimental about her late husband's forge

name: Tobias
personality: warm, unhurried, keeps pouring because somebody has to; the last hearth in town

name: Petra
personality: precise, clipped, counts her jars twice; believes in remedies the way others believe in gods

name: Sela
personality: chatty, generous, bakes at four in the morning because the smell makes people brave

name: Father Bren
personality: soft-spoken, doubting, keeps the candles lit for a congregation that stopped coming

name: Old Wendel
role: chicken keeper; sells charms on the side
personality: keeps chickens and a shelf of trinkets nobody quite believes in; nods at passersby; has very little to say

name: Eddar
role: recluse; mends clothes for Crooked Lane
personality: Tam Eddar's sister, and the only one left to carry the name. Twenty years a recluse since her brother went under the hill with Garrick's expedition and didn't come back — no body, nothing to bury. Grief settled into her long ago, like furniture. Opens her door four inches. Sela sends bread; the captain looks in on her; none of them have ever once discussed why.

name: Dorrin
personality: ledger-minded and chatty; counts everything twice and treats stock lists like scripture. The robberies are unmaking him line by line.
